D.quote: As our nation pauses on Veterans Day to recognize the sacrifice and service of veterans, the House has taken a major step to ensure medically retired veterans get the full support and benefits they have earned,” Courtney said.

This bill builds on a proven model already used throughout the VA benefits system, extending independent assistance to veterans utilizing one of the most important benefits they have earned through military service.
Senator Rosen has been a champion for Nevada’s veterans, working to ensure they have access to all the care and benefits they have earned.

R.quote: Honoring our veterans must go beyond words, it means ensuring they receive the care and benefits they have earned.
Our veterans have sacrificed so much in service to our country, and we have a responsibility to ensure they receive the care and benefits they have earned
I am proud to support this bipartisan resolution recognizing their service, and I remain committed to ensuring our veterans receive the recognition, care, and benefits they have earned.
